identity_basis: Broad-face/opening ratio identifies the original 240 mm family, not the 192.55 mm alternate. D24 relieved is the selected supplied design; the hidden skirt depth is not independently identifiable in this capture.
owner_assumption: Treat the printed form as exactly matching CAD. Use it as a dimensional reference; discrepancies on the form are reconstruction/feature-selection effects under this assumption, not evidence of printing error.
scope: Separate new-state diagnostic. Do not modify the primary scan, its registration, accepted physical measurements or existing print files.

calibration.basis: Robust circle fit to the complete outer rim section approximately 2 mm behind the fitted front face. The shallower section crosses reconstructed face dips and is not a complete clean rim. Deeper sections test edge blending into the wall, not independent accuracy bounds.

tip_method.notes: Fit a circle to the projected convex hull of the foremost cap band; use its center and foremost captured Z. The 2 mm A band reaches the enlarged nut and is excluded from the rod-tip estimate. No fitting to the caliper result. These are cap-center diagnostics, not precision shaft axes.

decision.current_12_by_8_slots: Retain the existing observed placement as the baseline. Do not move centers or shrink both dimensions on the strength of this scan alone.
decision.next_trial: If less play is worth testing, use removable sacrificial locator inserts/gauges on the existing form first. Try the real rods with end nuts removed and adjust locally; a second full-size print is not required to learn this. This assessment does not release insert geometry or a tighter full form.
decision.physical_checks: Ordinary fit checks remain: unforced insertion/removal, intended face seating, available control access and independent bracing. A static scan does not establish repeatability or completion of these checks.
